# Bundled browser libraries

- Marked 18.1.0, `lib/marked.umd.js` from the `marked` npm package.
  Source: https://github.com/markedjs/marked. License: `marked-LICENSE`.
- DOMPurify 3.4.16, `dist/purify.min.js` from the `dompurify` npm package.
  Source: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify. License: `dompurify-LICENSE`.

These files are served locally. The viewer sanitizes Markdown output before
inserting it into the document and blocks embedded media and forms.
